summary: Wire optional legacy terminal retirement regressions into required CI

delivery.outcome: Run the explicit legacy retirement regression suite whenever its optional adapter is present, while the pre-adapter baseline remains valid.
nonGoals: No change to adapter code, lease identity, ownership or publication authority
No skipped regression when the adapter exists; no required check removal

architecture.decision: Add one explicit Linux workflow step: when the distributed adapter exists, require its regression file and execute it. Before adapter integration there is no legacy adapter to test. Preserve the existing suite-wiring assertion and all platform gates.
interfaceChanges: Explicit mandatory test invocation when the optional legacy adapter is distributed
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent protected publication, retaining the mandatory suite-wiring gate.

commands: Execute actual workflow step with adapter absent and present
validation.evidence: The baseline succeeds without the optional adapter; its presence runs 17 regressions and missing regression input fails.
Suite-wiring contract, deterministic governance, fresh exact-head/base required CI and independent App publication.
